text_block_list.text:
After that, we spent day after day throwing ourselves into
training together for the upcoming Divisional Meet.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: *gasp*, *pant*! *wheeze*... *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...N-No way, I'm good!
If I tap out here, there's no way I'm gonna win...!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *gasp*... *wheeeeze*!

And then... the day before the Divisional Meet.
As I turned around to head home, Tosen Jordan grabbed my arm.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hey. Sorry if this sounds weird, but... I, like...
...I think I want to win right now more than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So... what if. What if I lose? What do I do then?
Ahaha. If that happens... maybe this time, I'll never again—
choice_data_list: You've got this. You've built up the real skill for it.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
choice_data_list: You'll definitely win. I give you my word.
You'll definitely win. I give you my word.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Pfft.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you, like, way too confident in me?
That's hilarious, honestly!
And then, the day finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look, Tosen Jordan's running. Guess she's back, huh?
Come to think of it, she's been training really hard lately.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Career Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. The other day she seemed to lose heart halfway through and gave up.
Hopefully, she can just finish the race today...

Amidst a whirlwind of mixed feelings—
the Divisional Meet's 2000m Turf race is underway!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(—Stay cool, stay cool, just like we practiced!
...Heh, looking good! —I've totally got this!)

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The race is already heading into the fourth corner! Tosen Jordan has
taken a great position! Will she be able to maintain the lead—?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Outta the way, outta the way, outta the waaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—And here comes Gold Ship with an explosive surge!
She's steadily pulling ahead of Tosen Jordan!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"The gap's crazy wide. The gap between me and my classmates, I mean.
Like, haven't I lost enough for a lifetime already? I just lose, and lose, and lose."

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (—...What if. What if I lose here?)

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (What if this time... I really never wanna run ever again?)

"Your desire to win is your greatest weapon."
—"You'll definitely win. I give you my word."

"Your desire to win is your greatest weapon."
—"You'll definitely win. I give you my word."

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(............Kh.
Come on, why are you always saying the exact same thing?!)

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
—Screw this...!!
I'm taking this all the waaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what?! Tosen Jordan?! Tosen Jordan is closing
in on Gold Ship with tremendous momentum!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahhhhh—!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
It's a dead heat! Will it be Gold Ship?! Or Tosen Jordan?!
Claiming victory in this nail-biting showdown is—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: TOSEN JORDAN—!!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Haah... haah... haaah... whew...

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Aahh...
...Hehehe, that really does feel awesome.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I'm beat. Today, I'm totally gonna do a face mask,
get an oil massage, light some scented candles, and pass out!

Her thrilling comeback sparked immense excitement,
and the 2000m Turf race concluded amidst roaring applause.
choice_data_list: That was truly an amazing race.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Geez, I heard you already! How many times are you gonna say it?
Seriously, even during the race, you were just...

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So, like, today's the last day of our training together, right?
So, um... Do you, like... have an assigned horsegirl yet?

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
If you don't, I mean, I guess I could take pity on you and let you train me?
Like, if you're just wandering around without a trainee, you might get fired, right~?

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Well, only if you're down for it, of course.

Despite her casual tone, the look in Tosen Jordan's eyes
was completely serious. I didn't have a single reason to refuse.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Heh.
...Welp, guess that settles it. Looking forward to working with ya☆
Just then—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: FOUNDCHAAAAAA!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I've been looking everywhere for ya, you in the blue! Listen up—
you're seriously pumped, jacked, blazing, and stacked to the brim, ain'tcha?!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wanna dig a hole straight to Brazil with me?! Huh?! Huh?!
I'll letcha feel the heat of the Earth's mantle! Up close and personal!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh? What? Who is this weirdo?!
I literally have no idea what you're even saying!!

From that day on, Tosen Jordan would find herself constantly chased around
by Gold Ship... but that's a story for another time.
